description: the docs index: search, proactive surfacing, memory, and the skills, rules and MCP-docs indexes

slash.name: raglit
slash.description: docs index (raglit): bare shows status, auto starts it every session

include.help: FILE|DIR... — add to this workspace's index and keep up to date: a directory is WATCHED (raglit re-reads changed and new files); a file is read once. add-document reads a directory once, without watching

add-document.help: FILE|DIR... — read into this workspace's index ONCE: a directory's files as they are now; later changes and new files are not read (include watches a directory)

exclude.help: GLOB [--keep] — stop indexing paths that match GLOB in this workspace's index, and remove the ones indexed (--keep: only stop new ones). GLOB matches the absolute path (**/build/** is a directory anywhere); a GLOB with no / matches the file name (*.log)

unexclude.help: GLOB — index paths that match GLOB again (an exclude's GLOB, as typed); removed documents come back at raglit's next read of a watched directory, or with include or add-document

excludes.help: this workspace's index: its exclude GLOBs (ignore), the builtin ones, and allow (exempt from builtin)
